summary: Pause becomes a Godot-side fact with one owner: a GamePause autoload holding a set of reasons, the single guard on the one call that advances campaign time, and a small accessibility settings surface that pauses while it is open.

coordination.notes: Godot-only lane; no Rust file is touched. godot-rust/src/strategy/tick.rs already settles the design -- there is no `paused` field in ExpeditionState, no paused branch in the tick and no host clock, so a paused game is a game whose bridge is not calling. This lane therefore adds no second answer in Rust; it makes Godot the one caller that can be stopped. game/project.godot takes an append at the END of [autoload] only, per the parallel-lane keep-both-tails rule; two other lanes append there too. campaign_session.gd is touched in exactly two hunks -- one guard call inside the existing resolve_midnight wrapper and one new function beside it -- and B8 owns that file's save/load functions. The refusal reuses the session's existing unavailable_state() dictionary with its error replaced, so no second rejection shape enters the codebase.
